job.job_description:
We're looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to build intelligent, production-ready AI solutions that can understand, reason, and act.

What You'll Do

Build and integrate AI agents and LLM applications
Develop AI-powered workflows and automations
Work with APIs, RAG, tools, and enterprise systems
Build and deploy scalable AI applications
Collaborate across AI, Data, Cloud, and DevOps
What We're Looking For

34 years of experience in AI/ML or Software Engineering
Strong Python skills
Experience with LLMs and Generative AI
Understanding of AI agents, RAG, APIs, and integrations
Experience with cloud platforms is a plus
Strong problem-solving and engineering mindset
Why Join Us

Work on real-world Agentic AI, Generative AI, Data, Cloud, and Automation projects while building production-ready intelligent systems.
